paths.description: Homepage and primary catalog template; tested desktop/mobile, preferences, performance, security, privacy, crawlability, accessibility, and memory.
Telugu 2026 category listing, representing archive/list templates.
Vadala movie detail, representing movie information/detail templates.
Search results journey for “Vadala”, representing the primary form flow and failure state.

findings.summary: The fixed dark palette ignores a light color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: Light-emulated and default screenshots are byte-identical (211,236 bytes), while authored CSS fixes dark RGB surfaces and declares no color-scheme.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and derive surfaces from preference-aware tokens such as light-dark().

findings.summary: The page does not adapt when higher contrast is requested.
findings.evidence: The prefers-contrast: more probe matched, but DOM/CSS inspection found no preference-specific styling.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prefers-contrast: more layer for muted text, borders, focus indicators, and scrollbar colors.

findings.summary: Full-page navigation has no view-transition treatment.
findings.evidence: DOM and modern-feature probes found no authored view-transition rules on this multi-page catalog.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-origin cross-document view transitions as progressive enhancement for category and detail navigation.

findings.summary: Navigation provides no persistent location or return affordance on very long pages.
findings.evidence: Mobile layout measured a 7,383px homepage and 4,917px detail page; screenshots show navigation only at the top.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a compact, accessible sticky navigation or back-to-top affordance that responds to scroll state.

findings.summary: A transparent third-party ad overlay intercepts the entire visible page.
findings.evidence: The active probe found #dontfoid fixed at 780×493 with z-index 2147483647; elementFromPoint at three viewport locations returned the transparent overlay. Lighthouse also observed an unnamed full-viewport affiliate link.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the ad script and injected overlay. Never place transparent click targets over content; make any sponsorship explicit, bounded, and non-blocking.

findings.summary: Responsiveness is page-wide and breakpoint-bound rather than component-aware.
findings.evidence: DOM CSS contains multiple viewport media-query bands but the modern-feature probe found zero container queries.
findings.suggestedFix: Use container queries for reusable movie grids, sidebar widgets, and search components while retaining sensible viewport fallbacks.

findings.summary: The primary browse/search journey is unreliable.
findings.evidence: The transparent overlay sits above all viewport controls, and direct search remained on a Cloudflare “Performing security verification” page after an 8-second wait.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the overlay and configure bot protection so normal searches complete, with a clear fallback and retry path.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts and eager images delay useful rendering.
findings.evidence: HAR measured 50 requests/586,064 bytes, including 165,865 bytes for gtag and 67,168 bytes from acscdn; 28 below-fold images lacked lazy loading. Trace LCP was 2.73s.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove ad scripts, load analytics only after consent, lazy-load below-fold images, and confirm parser-inserted scripts are deferred or async.

findings.summary: The page downloads substantial unused JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports an estimated 94 KiB unused JavaScript saving, largely in third-party code.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the advertising bundle and reduce analytics payloads before considering code splitting.

findings.summary: The injected full-screen affiliate link has no accessible name.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse/axe identified body.home > a#dontfoid in the tab order with no visible or accessible text and a 412×823 bounding box.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the injected link. Any legitimate link must have a discernible name and must not cover unrelated content.

findings.summary: Sidebar list items are exposed with invalid list structure.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse/axe flagged three sidebar li.widget elements whose parent is not exposed as a list.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a semantic ul/ol parent without a conflicting role, or replace non-list widgets with section elements and headings.

findings.summary: Movie details have social metadata but no structured movie data.
findings.evidence: Detail recon found Open Graph tags, but the page-wide probe found zero JSON-LD scripts and zero microdata items.
findings.suggestedFix: Add valid Movie JSON-LD with name, image, description, date, director, actors, genre, and language.

findings.summary: Key security response headers are absent.
findings.evidence: Headers probe found no CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy; only X-Frame-Options was present.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy HSTS, nosniff, a restrictive CSP/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Tracking and advertising run without an evident consent boundary.
findings.evidence: Tracker probe found seven third-party origins, Google Tag Manager/Analytics, acscdn, usrpubtrk, and adexchangerapid. HAR attributed 585,677 of 586,064 bytes to origins other than the requested host.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove opaque ad/tracker vendors, minimize analytics, and gate non-essential processing behind informed consent.

findings.summary: Structured metadata is absent from catalog and detail templates.
findings.evidence: Raw/rendered content is crawlable, but probes found no JSON-LD or microdata on either template.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish schema.org WebSite/SearchAction and Movie JSON-LD matching visible content.

findings.summary: All catalog images use legacy, non-responsive delivery.
findings.evidence: Images probe found 32/32 JPEGs, 32/32 without srcset, and 28 below-fold images without lazy loading.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP sources, responsive srcset/sizes, and lazy-load below-fold posters while prioritizing the LCP candidate.

findings.summary: The public catalog is crawlable but exposes no machine-readable capabilities.
findings.evidence: Discoverability coverage was 99%, yet probes found no JSON-LD, microdata, WebMCP tools, or agent-oriented search capability.
findings.suggestedFix: Start with standards-based JSON-LD and a machine-readable search surface; add WebMCP only as progressive enhancement where appropriate.
